relationships.subject: SCN9A rs6746030
relationships.evidence_quote: those with GA and AA genotypes were less likely to have high pain tolerance (probability = 0.68, SE = 0.07, 95%CI (0.54, 0.79)) than those with the GG genotype

relationships.subject: combat athletes
relationships.evidence_quote: the probability of having a high pain threshold was higher in the combat athletes’ group (probability = 0.26, SE = 0.04, 95%CI (0.20, 0.34)) than in controls

relationships.subject: SCN9A rs6746030
relationships.evidence_quote: The effect of the genotype was not significant, B = 0.03, SE = 0.37, Z = 0.07, p = 0.944

key_findings: SCN9A rs6746030 GA/AA genotypes were associated with lower pain tolerance (OR 0.41) but not pain threshold.
Combat athletes had higher pain threshold and tolerance independent of genotype.
